item.title: Litigation-Related Update: Sileiri Doe Class Members May Request Reopening or Reconsideration of an Adverse Decision Without a Fee
item.description: On Sept. 28, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts issued an order requiring DHS to remediate certain adverse consequences for the class of aliens paroled into the United States after scheduling an appointment through the CBP One mobile app, and whose parole was terminated by the federal government via mass email in April 2025. Sileiri Doe v. DHS, 1:25-cv-12245-ADB (D. Mass).
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: Aliens in Idaho Charged for Illegal Voting
item.description: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted an investigation that resulted in charges against two Canadian aliens residing in eastern Idaho for unlawfully voting in the 2022 general election.
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: Grocery Store Manager Convicted of Immigration Document Fraud, Obstruction of Two Federal Labor Investigations, and Conspiracy
item.description: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided pivotal assistance to the case resulting in the conviction of Karla Montoya, 45, of Sacramento.
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: Six Charged in Large-Scale Marriage Fraud Ring
item.description: Six individuals in Massachusetts have been charged with allegedly arranging sham marriages to fraudulently obtain immigration status for illegal aliens.
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: Alien from South Africa Charged with Unlawful Voting
item.description: A South African alien and lawful permanent resident was charged with unlawfully voting in the November 2024 federal election. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided valuable assistance during the investigation.
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: Canadian Alien Charged with Illegal Voting
item.description: A grand jury returned an indictment charging Sandra Madeline Watson, 59, of Louisville, with illegal voting by an alien in a federal election.
item.dc:creator: USCIS

item.title: USCIS Assisted in ICE Investigation Leading to Arrest of 370 Alien Offenders in Massachusetts
item.description: BOSTON – U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided valuable assistance to the investigation that led to the apprehension of 370 illegal aliens in Massachusetts between March 18 and 23.
item.dc:creator: USCIS
